adjoint_degree5_control.obstruction: For lambda!=0, W=T(Tr27 Phi²-w²)+lambda Tr27 Phi^5 has no F-flat solution with Phi proportional to Y; the fifth-order Cartan derivative is not proportional to Y.
adjoint_degree5_control.scope: No statement excluding cancellations from Hbar-Phi-H couplings or higher E6 invariants.

cubic_mass_pairs: Ten of 27 chiral fields acquire mass |lambda|sqrt(|a|²+|b|²) in a single 27 flavor, leaving 17 massless; rank only, not an SM physical mass claim.

explicit_superpotential.D_flat: Each aligned 27bar cancels its partner 27 moment map for every compact E6 generator; the Cartan adjoint Phi is normal and has zero adjoint moment map.
explicit_superpotential.F_flat: S1=S2=T=0, <barHa,Ha>=va², Tr27 Phi²=w²; cubic polarizations vanish for common-row rank-one A-sector VEVs
explicit_superpotential.gauge_symmetry: E6 -> SU5 by H1,H2 and SU5 -> SM Lie algebra by Phi proportional to Y

unresolved: Adjoint direction not dynamically selected, at least three Cartan complex moduli, unknown full coupled scalar Hessian and realistic fermion masses.
